name: Greater Caucasus
region: Elbrus, Kazbek, Ushba and the central Caucasus.
sources: Shahgedanova, M. et al. (2014) Changes in the mountain river discharge in the northern Caucasus. Global and Planetary Change 118
Hersbach, H. et al. (2020) The ERA5 global reanalysis. QJRMS 146:1999-2049 (monthly climatology 1991-2020, 300 hPa winds)
notes: Early summer is stormiest; August is the most reliable month. Whiteout on the Elbrus plateau is the dominant hazard.
